subroutine get_amat_3d(mol, nshell, offset, hubbard, gexp, rcut, wsc, alpha, amat)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Number of shells per atom
   integer, intent(in) :: nshell(:)
   !> Index offset for each atom
   integer, intent(in) :: offset(:)
   !> Hubbard parameter of the shells
   real(wp), intent(in) :: hubbard(:, :, :, :)
   !> Exponent of the interaction kernel
   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
   !> Long-range cutoff
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
   !> Wigner-Seitz cell
   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
   !> Convergence factor
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Coulomb matrix
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat(:, :)

   integer :: iat, jat, izp, jzp, img, ii, jj, ish, jsh
   real(wp) :: vec(3), gam, wsw, dtmp, rtmp, vol, aval
   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)

   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) shared(amat) &
   !$omp shared(mol, nshell, offset, hubbard, gexp, wsc, dtrans, rtrans, alpha, vol, rcut) &
   !$omp private(iat, izp, jat, jzp, ii, jj, ish, jsh, gam, wsw, vec, dtmp, rtmp, aval)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      izp = mol%id(iat)
      ii = offset(iat)
      do jat = 1, iat-1
         jzp = mol%id(jat)
         jj = offset(jat)
         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
            call get_amat_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, 0.0_wp, rtrans, rtmp)
            do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
               do jsh = 1, nshell(jat)
                  gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, jzp, izp)
                  call get_amat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dtmp)
                  aval = (dtmp + rtmp) * wsw
                  amat(jj+jsh, ii+ish) = amat(jj+jsh, ii+ish) + aval
                  amat(ii+ish, jj+jsh) = amat(ii+ish, jj+jsh) + aval
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do

      wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(iat, iat), wp)
      do img = 1, wsc%nimg(iat, iat)
         vec = wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, iat, iat))
         call get_amat_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, 0.0_wp, rtrans, rtmp)
         rtmp = rtmp - 2 * alpha / sqrtpi
         do ish = 1, nshell(iat)
            do jsh = 1, ish-1
               gam = hubbard(jsh, ish, izp, izp)
               call get_amat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dtmp)
               aval = (dtmp + rtmp + gam) * wsw
               amat(ii+jsh, ii+ish) = amat(ii+jsh, ii+ish) + aval
               amat(ii+ish, ii+jsh) = amat(ii+ish, ii+jsh) + aval
            end do
            gam = hubbard(ish, ish, izp, izp)
            call get_amat_dir_3d(vec, gam, gexp, rcut, alpha, dtrans, dtmp)
            aval = (dtmp + rtmp + gam) * wsw
            amat(ii+ish, ii+ish) = amat(ii+ish, ii+ish) + aval
         end do
      end do

   end do

end subroutine get_amat_3d

!> Calculate real space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
subroutine get_amat_dir_3d(rij, gam, gexp, rcut, alp, trans, amat)
   !> Distance between pair
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   !> Hubbard parameter
   real(wp), intent(in) :: gam
   !> Exponent for interaction kernel
   real(wp), intent(in) :: gexp
   !> Long-range cutoff
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
   !> Convergence factor
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   !> Translation vectors to consider
   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   !> Interaction matrix element
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat

   integer :: itr
   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fcut

   amat = 0.0_wp

   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
      r1 = norm2(vec)
      if (r1 < eps) cycle
      fcut = fsmooth(r1, rcut)
      tmp = fcut/(r1**gexp + gam**(-gexp))**(1.0_wp/gexp) + (1.0_wp-fcut)/r1 &
         & - erf(alp*r1)/r1
      amat = amat + tmp
   end do

end subroutine get_amat_dir_3d

!> Calculate reciprocal space contributions for a pair under 3D periodic boundary conditions
subroutine get_amat_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, qpc, trans, amat)
   !> Distance between pair

   !> Volume of cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   !> Convergence factor

   real(wp), intent(in) :: qpc
   !> Translation vectors to consider

   fac = 4*pi/vol

- `wsc` (Wigner-Seitz cell) with `wsc%nimg(jat, iat)` and `wsc%trans` and `wsc%tridx`.

   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol

   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3

   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)

   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq) &
   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, rad, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(iat, jat, img, vec, rr, wsw, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))

      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)

      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)

      sink = sin(gv)*expk
      cosk = cos(gv)*expk

      amat_sd(:) = amat_sd + 2*vec*sink
      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd + spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * cosk
      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*cosk
      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*cosk
      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*cosk
      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*cosk
      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*cosk
      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*cosk

end subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d

pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, trans, &
      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)

   integer :: itr
   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, arg, arg2, alp2, e1, e2, erft, expt

   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   alp2 = alp*alp

   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
      r1 = norm2(vec)
      if (r1 < eps) cycle
      g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
      g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
      g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
      fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp3)
      fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp5)

      arg = r1*alp
      arg2 = arg*arg
      expt = exp(-arg2)/sqrtpi
      erft = -erf(arg)*g1
      e1 = g1*g1 * (erft + 2*expt*alp)
      e2 = g1*g1 * (e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)

      tmp = fdmp3 * g3 + e1
      amat_sd = amat_sd + vec * tmp
      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd(:, :) + unity * (fdmp5*g3 + e1) &
         & - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * (3 * (g5*fdmp5 + e2))
      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
   end do

end subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d

subroutine get_multipole_gradient(self, mol, cache, qat, dpat, qpat, dEdr, gradient, sigma)

!> Evaluate multipole derivatives for finite systems
subroutine get_multipole_gradient_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, qat, dpat, qpat, &
      & dEdr, gradient, sigma)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Atomic partial charges
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qat(:)
   !> Atomic dipole moments
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   !> Atomic quadrupole moments
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: dEdr(:)
   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. strain deformations
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)

   integer :: iat, jat
   real(wp) :: r1, r2, vec(3), rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG(3), dS(3, 3)
   real(wp) :: ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) reduction(+:dEdr, gradient, sigma) &
   !$omp shared(mol, kdmp3, kdmp5, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
   !$omp private(iat, jat, r1, r2, vec, rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG, dS, &
   !$omp& ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, iat - 1
         rr = 0.5_wp*(rad(iat)+rad(jat))
         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat)
         r1 = norm2(vec)
         r2 = r1 * r1
         g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
         g7 = g5 * g1 * g1

         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
         ddmp3 = -3*g5*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3-1.0_wp)*g5
         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
         ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5-fdmp5)

         dpiqj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, iat))*qat(jat)
         qidpj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, jat))*qat(iat)
         fddr = 3.0_wp*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
         dg(:) = - ddmp3*vec * (dpiqj - qidpj) &
            & + fdmp3*g3*(qat(iat)*dpat(:, jat) - qat(jat)*dpat(:, iat))

module tblite_coulomb_ewald
   use mctc_env, only : wp
   use mctc_io_constants, only : pi
   use mctc_io_math, only : matdet_3x3, matinv_3x3
   implicit none
   private

   public :: get_alpha, get_dir_cutoff, get_rec_cutoff

   real(wp), parameter :: twopi = 2 * pi
   real(wp), parameter :: sqrtpi = sqrt(pi)
   real(wp), parameter :: eps = sqrt(epsilon(0.0_wp))

   !> Evaluator for interaction term
   type, abstract :: term_type
   contains
      !> Interaction at specified distance
      procedure(get_value), deferred :: get_value
   end type term_type

   abstract interface
      !> Interaction at specified distance
      pure function get_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(val)
         import :: term_type, wp
         !> Instance of interaction
         class(term_type), intent(in) :: self
         !> Distance between the two atoms
         real(wp), intent(in) :: dist
         !> Parameter of the Ewald summation
         real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
         !> Volume of the real space unit cell
         real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
         !> Value of the interaction
         real(wp) :: val
      end function get_value
   end interface

   !> Real space Coulombic interaction 1/R
   type, extends(term_type) :: dir_term
   contains
      procedure :: get_value => dir_value
   end type dir_term

   !> Reciprocal space Coulombic interaction 1/R in 3D
   type, extends(term_type) :: rec_3d_term
   contains
      procedure :: get_value => rec_3d_value
   end type rec_3d_term

   !> Real space Coulombic interaction 1/R^2
   type, extends(term_type) :: dir_mp_term
   contains
      procedure :: get_value => dir_mp_value
   end type dir_mp_term

   !> Reciprocal space Coulombic interaction 1/R^2 in 3D
   type, extends(term_type) :: rec_3d_mp_term
   contains
      procedure :: get_value => rec_3d_mp_value
   end type rec_3d_mp_term

contains


!> Convenience interface to determine Ewald splitting parameter
subroutine get_alpha(lattice, alpha, multipole)
   !> Lattice vectors
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:, :)
   !> Estimated Ewald splitting parameter
   real(wp), intent(out) :: alpha
   !> Multipole expansion is used
   logical, intent(in) :: multipole

   real(wp) :: vol, rec_lat(3, 3)
   class(term_type), allocatable :: dirv, recv

   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(lattice))
   rec_lat = twopi*transpose(matinv_3x3(lattice))
   if (multipole) then
      dirv = dir_mp_term()
      recv = rec_3d_mp_term()
   else
      dirv = dir_term()
      recv = rec_3d_term()
   end if

   call search_alpha(lattice, rec_lat, vol, eps, dirv, recv, alpha)
end subroutine get_alpha


!> Get optimal alpha-parameter for the Ewald summation by finding alpha, where
!> decline of real and reciprocal part of Ewald are equal.
subroutine search_alpha(lattice, rec_lat, volume, tolerance, dirv, recv, alpha)
   !> Lattice vectors
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:,:)
   !> Reciprocal vectors
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rec_lat(:,:)
   !> Volume of the unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance for difference in real and rec. part
   real(wp), intent(in) :: tolerance
   !> Real-space interaction term
   class(term_type), intent(in) :: dirv
   !> Reciprocal space interaction term
   class(term_type), intent(in) :: recv
   !> Optimal alpha
   real(wp), intent(out) :: alpha

   real(wp) :: alpl, alpr, rlen, dlen, diff
   real(wp), parameter :: alpha0 = sqrt(epsilon(0.0_wp))
   integer, parameter :: niter = 30
   integer :: ibs, stat

   rlen = sqrt(minval(sum(rec_lat(:,:)**2, dim=1)))
   dlen = sqrt(minval(sum(lattice(:,:)**2, dim=1)))

   stat = 0
   alpha = alpha0
   diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume)
   do while (diff < -tolerance .and. alpha <= huge(1.0_wp))
      alpha = 2.0_wp * alpha
      diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume)
   end do
   if (alpha > huge(1.0_wp)) then
      stat = 1
   elseif (alpha == alpha0) then
      stat = 2
   end if

   if (stat == 0) then
      alpl = 0.5_wp * alpha
      do while (diff < tolerance .and. alpha <= huge(1.0_wp))
         alpha = 2.0_wp * alpha
         diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume)
      end do
      if (alpha > huge(1.0_wp)) then
         stat = 3
      end if
   end if

   if (stat == 0) then
      alpr = alpha
      alpha = (alpl + alpr) * 0.5_wp
      ibs = 0
      diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume)
      do while (abs(diff) > tolerance .and. ibs <= niter)
         if (diff < 0) then
            alpl = alpha
         else
            alpr = alpha
         end if
         alpha = (alpl + alpr) * 0.5_wp
         diff = rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume)
         ibs = ibs + 1
      end do
      if (ibs > niter) then
         stat = 4
      end if
   end if

   if (stat /= 0) then
      alpha = 0.25_wp
   end if

end subroutine search_alpha


!> Return cutoff for reciprocal contributions
function get_rec_cutoff(alpha, volume, conv) result(x)
   !> Parameter of Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance value
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Magnitude of reciprocal vector
   real(wp) :: x

   class(term_type), allocatable :: term

   term = rec_3d_term()
   x = search_cutoff(term, alpha, volume, conv)

end function get_rec_cutoff


!> Return cutoff for real-space contributions
function get_dir_cutoff(alpha, conv) result(x)
   !> Parameter of Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Magnitude of real-space vector
   real(wp) :: x

   real(wp), parameter :: volume = 0.0_wp
   class(term_type), allocatable :: term

   term = dir_term()
   x = search_cutoff(term, alpha, volume, conv)

end function get_dir_cutoff


!> Search for cutoff value of interaction term
function search_cutoff(term, alpha, volume, conv) result(x)
   !> Interaction term
   class(term_type), intent(in) :: term
   !> Parameter of Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance value
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Magnitude of reciprocal vector
   real(wp) :: x

   real(wp), parameter :: init = sqrt(epsilon(0.0_wp))
   integer, parameter :: miter = 30
   real(wp) :: xl, xr, yl, yr, y
   integer :: iter

   x = init
   y = term%get_value(x, alpha, volume)
   do while (y > conv .and. x <= huge(1.0_wp))
      x = 2.0_wp * x
      y = term%get_value(x, alpha, volume)
   end do

   xl = 0.5_wp * x
   yl = term%get_value(xl, alpha, volume)
   xr = x
   yr = y

   do iter = 1, miter
      if (yl - yr <= conv) exit
      x = 0.5_wp * (xl + xr)
      y = term%get_value(x, alpha, volume)
      if (y >= conv) then
         xl = x
         yl = y
      else
         xr = x
         yr = y
      end if
   end do

end function search_cutoff


!> Returns the difference in the decrease of the real and reciprocal parts of the
!> Ewald sum. In order to make the real space part shorter than the reciprocal
!> space part, the values are taken at different distances for the real and the
!> reciprocal space parts.
pure function rec_dir_diff(alpha, dirv, recv, rlen, dlen, volume) result(diff)
   !> Parameter for the Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Procedure pointer to real-space routine
   class(term_type), intent(in) :: dirv
   !> Procedure pointer to reciprocal routine
   class(term_type), intent(in) :: recv
   !> Length of the shortest reciprocal space vector in the sum
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rlen
   !> Length of the shortest real space vector in the sum
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dlen
   !> Volume of the real space unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Difference between changes in the two terms
   real(wp) :: diff

   diff = ((recv%get_value(4*rlen, alpha, volume) - recv%get_value(5*rlen, alpha, volume))) &
      & - (dirv%get_value(2*dlen, alpha, volume) - dirv%get_value(3*dlen, alpha, volume))

end function rec_dir_diff


!> Returns the max. value of a term in the reciprocal space part of the Ewald
!> summation for a given vector length.
pure function rec_3d_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(rval)
   !> Instance of interaction
   class(rec_3d_term), intent(in) :: self
   !> Length of the reciprocal space vector
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dist
   !> Parameter of the Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the real space unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   !> Reciprocal term
   real(wp) :: rval

   rval = 4.0_wp*pi*(exp(-0.25_wp*dist*dist/(alpha**2))/(vol*dist*dist))

end function rec_3d_value


!> Returns the max. value of a term in the reciprocal space part of the Ewald
!> summation for a given vector length.
pure function rec_3d_mp_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(rval)
   !> Instance of interaction
   class(rec_3d_mp_term), intent(in) :: self
   !> Length of the reciprocal space vector
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dist
   !> Parameter of the Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the real space unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   !> Reciprocal term
   real(wp) :: rval

   real(wp) :: g2

   g2 = dist*dist

   rval = 4.0_wp*pi*(exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alpha**2))/vol)

end function rec_3d_mp_value


!> Direct space interaction at specified distance
pure function dir_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(val)
   !> Instance of interaction
   class(dir_term), intent(in) :: self
   !> Distance between the two atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dist
   !> Parameter of the Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the real space unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   !> Value of the interaction
   real(wp) :: val

   val = erfc(alpha*dist)/dist
end function dir_value

!> Direct space interaction at specified distance
pure function dir_mp_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(val)
   !> Instance of interaction
   class(dir_mp_term), intent(in) :: self
   !> Distance between the two atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: dist
   !> Parameter of the Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the real space unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   !> Value of the interaction
   real(wp) :: val

   real(wp) :: arg

   arg = alpha * dist

   val = (2/sqrtpi*arg*exp(-arg*arg) + erfc(arg))/dist**3
end function dir_mp_value

end module tblite_coulomb_ewald

   458	!> Get interaction matrix for all multipole moments up to inverse cubic order
   459	subroutine get_multipole_matrix(self, mol, cache, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   460	   !> Instance of the multipole container
   461	   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   462	   !> Molecular structure data
   463	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   464	   !> Reusable data container
   465	   type(coulomb_cache), intent(inout) :: cache
   466	   !> Interation matrix for charges and dipoles
   467	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   468	   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   469	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   470	   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   471	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)
   472	
   473	   amat_sd(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
   474	   amat_dd(:, :, :, :) = 0.0_wp
   475	   amat_sq(:, :, :) = 0.0_wp
   476	   if (any(mol%periodic)) then
   477	      call get_multipole_matrix_3d(mol, cache%mrad, self%kdmp3, self%kdmp5, &
   478	         & cache%wsc, cache%alpha, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   479	   else
   480	      call get_multipole_matrix_0d(mol, cache%mrad, self%kdmp3, self%kdmp5, &
   481	         & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   482	   end if
   483	end subroutine get_multipole_matrix
   484	
   485	!> Calculate the multipole interaction matrix for finite systems
   486	subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   487	   !> Molecular structure data
   488	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   489	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   490	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   491	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   492	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   493	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   494	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   495	   !> Interaction matrix for charges and dipoles
   496	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   497	   !> Interaction matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   498	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   499	   !> Interaction matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   500	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)
   501	
   502	   integer :: iat, jat
   503	   real(wp) :: r1, vec(3), g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc(6), rr
   504	
   505	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   506	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   507	   !$omp private(r1, vec, g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc, rr)
   508	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   509	      do jat = 1, mol%nat
   510	         if (iat == jat) cycle
   511	         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
   512	         r1 = norm2(vec)
   513	         g1 = 1.0_wp / r1
   514	         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
   515	         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
   516	
   517	         rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat)) * g1
   518	         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp3)
   519	         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp5)
   520	
   521	         amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + vec * g3 * fdmp3
   522	         amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) &
   523	            & + unity * g3*fdmp5 - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * 3*g5*fdmp5
   524	         tc(2) = 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
   525	         tc(4) = 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
   526	         tc(5) = 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
   527	         tc(1) = vec(1)*vec(1)*g5*fdmp5
   528	         tc(3) = vec(2)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
   529	         tc(6) = vec(3)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
   530	         amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + tc
   531	      end do
   532	   end do
   533	end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d
   534	
   535	!> Evaluate multipole interaction matrix under 3D periodic boundary conditions
   536	subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, wsc, alpha, &
   537	      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   538	   !> Molecular structure data
   539	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   540	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   541	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   542	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   543	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   544	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   545	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   546	   !> Wigner-Seitz cell images
   547	   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
   548	   !> Convergence parameter for Ewald sum
   549	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   550	   !> Interation matrix for charges and dipoles
   551	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   552	   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   553	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   554	   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   555	   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)
   556	
   557	   integer :: iat, jat, img, k
   558	   real(wp) :: vec(3), rr, wsw, vol
   559	   real(wp) :: d_sd(3), d_dd(3, 3), d_sq(6), r_sd(3), r_dd(3, 3), r_sq(6)
   560	   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)
   561	
   562	   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
   563	   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
   564	   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)
   565	
   566	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   567	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq) &
   568	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, rad, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   569	   !$omp private(iat, jat, img, vec, rr, wsw, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
   570	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   571	      do jat = 1, mol%nat
   572	         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
   573	         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
   574	            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
   575	
   576	            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
   577	            call get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, rtrans, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
   578	            call get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq)
   579	
   580	            amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (d_sd + r_sd)
   581	            amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) + wsw * (r_dd + d_dd)
   582	            amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (r_sq + d_sq)
   583	         end do
   584	      end do
   585	   end do
   586	
   587	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
   588	   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, vol, alpha) private(iat, rr, k)
   589	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   590	      ! dipole-dipole selfenergy: -2/3·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) μ²(i)
   591	      rr = -2.0_wp/3.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
   592	      do k = 1, 3
   593	         amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) = amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) + 2*rr
   594	      end do
   595	
   596	      ! charge-quadrupole selfenergy: 4/9·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) q(i)Tr(θi)
   597	      ! (no actual contribution since quadrupoles are traceless)
   598	      rr = 4.0_wp/9.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
   599	      amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) = amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) + rr
   600	   end do
   601	end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d
   602	
   603	pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, trans, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   604	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   605	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   606	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   607	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   608	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
   609	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
   610	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)
   611	
   612	   integer :: itr
   613	   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, expk, sink, cosk, gv
   614	
   615	   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
   616	   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
   617	   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   618	   fac = 4*pi/vol
   619	
   620	   amat_dd(1, 1) = fac/6.0_wp
   621	   amat_dd(2, 2) = fac/6.0_wp
   622	   amat_dd(3, 3) = fac/6.0_wp
   623	   amat_sq([1, 3, 6]) = -fac/9.0_wp
   624	
   625	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
   626	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
   627	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
   628	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
   629	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
   630	      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
   631	      sink = sin(gv)*expk
   632	      cosk = cos(gv)*expk
   633	
   634	      amat_sd(:) = amat_sd + 2*vec*sink
   635	      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd + spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * cosk
   636	      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*cosk
   637	      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*cosk
   638	      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*cosk
   639	      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*cosk
   640	      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*cosk
   641	      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*cosk
   642	   end do
   643	
   644	end subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d
   645	
   646	pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, trans, &
   647	      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   648	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   649	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
   650	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   651	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   652	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   653	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   654	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
   655	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
   656	   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)
   657	
   658	   integer :: itr
   659	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, arg, arg2, alp2, e1, e2, erft, expt
   660	
   661	   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
   662	   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
   663	   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   664	   alp2 = alp*alp
   665	
   666	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
   667	      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
   668	      r1 = norm2(vec)
   669	      if (r1 < eps) cycle
   670	      g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
   671	      g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
   672	      g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
   673	      fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp3)
   674	      fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp5)
   675	
   676	      arg = r1*alp
   677	      arg2 = arg*arg
   678	      expt = exp(-arg2)/sqrtpi
   679	      erft = -erf(arg)*g1
   680	      e1 = g1*g1 * (erft + 2*expt*alp)
   681	      e2 = g1*g1 * (e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)
   682	
   683	      tmp = fdmp3 * g3 + e1
   684	      amat_sd = amat_sd + vec * tmp
   685	      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd(:, :) + unity * (fdmp5*g3 + e1) &
   686	         & - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * (3 * (g5*fdmp5 + e2))
   687	      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
   688	      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
   689	      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
   690	      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
   691	      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
   692	      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
   693	   end do
   694	
   695	end subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d
   696

   699	subroutine get_multipole_gradient(self, mol, cache, qat, dpat, qpat, dEdr, gradient, sigma)
   700	   !> Instance of the multipole container
   701	   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   702	   !> Molecular structure data
   703	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   704	   !> Reusable data container
   705	   type(coulomb_cache), intent(inout) :: cache
   706	   !> Atomic partial charges
   707	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qat(:)
   708	   !> Atomic dipole moments
   709	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   710	   !> Atomic quadrupole moments

   712	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii

   714	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
   715	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)

   721	         & qat, dpat, qpat, cache%wsc, cache%alpha, dEdr, gradient, sigma)
   722	   else

   724	         & qat, dpat, qpat, dEdr, gradient, sigma)

   727	
   728	!> Evaluate multipole derivatives for finite systems
   729	subroutine get_multipole_gradient_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, qat, dpat, qpat, &
   730	      & dEdr, gradient, sigma)
   731	   !> Molecular structure data
   732	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   733	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   734	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   735	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   736	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   737	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   738	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   739	   !> Atomic partial charges
   740	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qat(:)
   741	   !> Atomic dipole moments
   742	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   743	   !> Atomic quadrupole moments
   744	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
   745	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii
   746	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: dEdr(:)
   747	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
   748	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
   749	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. strain deformations
   750	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)
   751	
   752	   integer :: iat, jat
   753	   real(wp) :: r1, r2, vec(3), rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG(3), dS(3, 3)
   754	   real(wp) :: ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj
   755	
   756	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) reduction(+:dEdr, gradient, sigma) &
   757	   !$omp shared(mol, kdmp3, kdmp5, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
   758	   !$omp private(iat, jat, r1, r2, vec, rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG, dS, &
   759	   !$omp& ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj)
   760	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   761	      do jat = 1, iat - 1
   762	         rr = 0.5_wp*(rad(iat)+rad(jat))
   763	         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat)
   764	         r1 = norm2(vec)
   765	         r2 = r1 * r1
   766	         g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
   767	         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
   768	         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
   769	         g7 = g5 * g1 * g1
   770	
   771	         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
   772	         ddmp3 = -3*g5*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3-1.0_wp)*g5
   773	         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
   774	         ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5-fdmp5)
   775	
   776	         dpiqj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, iat))*qat(jat)
   777	         qidpj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, jat))*qat(iat)
   778	         fddr = 3.0_wp*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
   779	         dg(:) = - ddmp3*vec * (dpiqj - qidpj) &
   780	            & + fdmp3*g3*(qat(iat)*dpat(:, jat) - qat(jat)*dpat(:, iat))
   781	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dG, 2, 3) &
   782	            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
   783	
   784	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
   785	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
   786	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dG
   787	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dG
   788	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + dS
   789	
   790	         dpidpj = dot_product(dpat(:, jat), dpat(:, iat))
   791	         dpiv = dot_product(dpat(:, iat), vec)
   792	         dpjv = dot_product(dpat(:, jat), vec)
   793	         edd = dpidpj*r2 - 3*dpjv*dpiv
   794	         fddr = 3.0_wp*edd*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*(fdmp5/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
   795	         dg(:) = - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*dpidpj*vec &
   796	            & + 3.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*dpat(:, jat) + dpjv*dpat(:, iat)) &
   797	            & - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec
   798	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dg, 2, 3) &
   799	            & + spread(dg, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
   800	
   801	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
   802	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
   803	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dg
   804	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dg
   805	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + ds
   806	
   807	         eq = &
   808	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(2,iat) + qpat(2,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(2) &
   809	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(4,iat) + qpat(4,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(3) &
   810	            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(5,iat) + qpat(5,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(3) &
   811	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(1,iat) + qpat(1,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(1) &
   812	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(3,iat) + qpat(3,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(2) &
   813	            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(6,iat) + qpat(6,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(3)*vec(3)
   814	
   815	         fddr = eq * 3.0_wp*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*fdmp5/rr*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
   816	         dg(:) = - eq*ddmp5*g7*vec &
   817	            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(iat) * &
   818	            &[vec(1)*qpat(1,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(2,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(4,jat), &
   819	            & vec(1)*qpat(2,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(3,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(5,jat), &
   820	            & vec(1)*qpat(4,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,jat)] &
   821	            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(jat) * &
   822	            &[vec(1)*qpat(1,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(4,iat), &
   823	            & vec(1)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(3,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(5,iat), &
   824	            & vec(1)*qpat(4,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,iat)]
   825	         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dG, 2, 3) &
   826	            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
   827	
   828	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
   829	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr
   830	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dg
   831	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dg
   832	         sigma(:, :) = sigma + ds
   833	      end do
   834	   end do
   835	end subroutine get_multipole_gradient_0d
   836	
   837	!> Evaluate multipole derivatives under 3D periodic boundary conditions
   838	subroutine get_multipole_gradient_3d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, qat, dpat, qpat, wsc, alpha, &
   839	      & dEdr, gradient, sigma)
   840	   !> Molecular structure data
   841	   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   842	   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   843	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   844	   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   845	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   846	   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   847	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   848	   !> Atomic partial charges
   849	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qat(:)
   850	   !> Atomic dipole moments
   851	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: dpat(:, :)
   852	   !> Atomic quadrupole moments
   853	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(in) :: qpat(:, :)
   854	   !> Wigner-Seitz cell images
   855	   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
   856	   !> Convergence parameter for Ewald sum
   857	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   858	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii
   859	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: dEdr(:)
   860	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
   861	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
   862	   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. strain deformations
   863	   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)
   864	
   865	   integer :: iat, jat, img
   866	   real(wp) :: vec(3), dG(3), dGr(3), dGd(3), dS(3, 3), dSr(3, 3), dSd(3, 3)
   867	   real(wp) :: wsw, vol, rr, dE, dEd
   868	   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)
   869	
   870	   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
   871	   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
   872	   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)
   873	
   874	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) reduction(+:dEdr, gradient, sigma) &
   875	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
   876	   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)
   877	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   878	      do jat = 1, iat - 1
   879	         dE = 0.0_wp
   880	         dG(:) = 0.0_wp
   881	         dS(:, :) = 0.0_wp
   882	         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
   883	         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
   884	            vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat) + wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))
   885	            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
   886	
   887	            call get_damat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(jat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, jat), &
   888	               & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, jat), vol, alpha, rtrans, dGr, dSr)
   889	            call get_damat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(jat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, jat), &
   890	               & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, jat), rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, dEd, dGd, dSd)
   891	            dE = dE + dEd * wsw
   892	            dG = dG + (dGd + dGr) * wsw
   893	            dS = dS + (dSd + dSr) * wsw
   894	         end do
   895	         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + dE
   896	         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + dE
   897	         gradient(:, iat) = gradient(:, iat) + dG
   898	         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dG
   899	         sigma = sigma + dS
   900	      end do
   901	   end do
   902	
   903	   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) reduction(+:dEdr, sigma) &
   904	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
   905	   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)
   906	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
   907	      dE = 0.0_wp
   908	      dS(:, :) = 0.0_wp
   909	      wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(iat, iat), wp)
   910	      do img = 1, wsc%nimg(iat, iat)
   911	         vec(:) = wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, iat, iat))
   912	         rr = rad(iat)
   913	
   914	         call get_damat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(iat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, iat), &
   915	            & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, iat), vol, alpha, rtrans, dGr, dSr)
   916	         call get_damat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(iat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, iat), &
   917	            & qpat(:, iat), qpat(:, iat), rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, dEd, dGd, dSd)
   918	         dE = dE + dEd * wsw
   919	         dS = dS + (dSd + dSr) * wsw
   920	      end do
   921	      dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + dE
   922	      sigma = sigma + 0.5_wp * dS
   923	   end do
   924	end subroutine get_multipole_gradient_3d
   925	
   926	pure subroutine get_damat_sdq_rec_3d(rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, vol, alp, trans, dg, ds)
   927	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   928	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qi, qj, mi(3), mj(3), ti(6), tj(6)
   929	   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   930	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   931	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   932	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dg(3)
   933	   real(wp), intent(out) :: ds(3, 3)
   934	
   935	   integer :: itr, a, b
   936	   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, gv, expk, alp2, sink, cosk, dpiqj, qidpj
   937	   real(wp) :: qpiqj, qiqpj, dpiv, dpjv, tiv(3), tjv(3)
   938	
   939	   dg(:) = 0.0_wp
   940	   ds(:, :) = 0.0_wp
   941	   fac = 4*pi/vol
   942	   alp2 = alp*alp
   943	
   944	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
   945	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
   946	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
   947	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
   948	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
   949	      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/alp2)/g2
   950	      cosk = cos(gv)*expk
   951	      sink = sin(gv)*expk
   952	
   953	      dpiqj = dot_product(vec, mi)*qj
   954	      qidpj = dot_product(vec, mj)*qi
   955	
   956	      dg(:) = dg - 2*vec*cosk * (dpiqj - qidpj)
   957	      do b = 1, 3
   958	         do a = 1, 3
   959	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
   960	               & + 2 * sink * (dpiqj - qidpj) * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
   961	               & - sink*(vec(a)*(qj*mi(b) - qi*mj(b)) + vec(b)*(qj*mi(a) - qi*mj(a)))
   962	         end do
   963	      end do
   964	
   965	      dpiv = dot_product(mi, vec)
   966	      dpjv = dot_product(mj, vec)
   967	
   968	      dg(:) = dg + vec*sink*dpiv*dpjv
   969	      do b = 1, 3
   970	         do a = 1, 3
   971	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
   972	               & + cosk * dpiv*dpjv * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
   973	               & - 0.5_wp*cosk*(vec(a)*(mi(b)*dpjv + mj(b)*dpiv) + vec(b)*(mi(a)*dpjv + mj(a)*dpiv))
   974	         end do
   975	      end do
   976	
   977	      qiqpj = qi*(tj(1)*vec(1)*vec(1) + tj(3)*vec(2)*vec(2) + tj(6)*vec(3)*vec(3) &
   978	         & + 2*tj(2)*vec(1)*vec(2) + 2*tj(4)*vec(1)*vec(3) + 2*tj(5)*vec(2)*vec(3))
   979	      qpiqj = qj*(ti(1)*vec(1)*vec(1) + ti(3)*vec(2)*vec(2) + ti(6)*vec(3)*vec(3) &
   980	         & + 2*ti(2)*vec(1)*vec(2) + 2*ti(4)*vec(1)*vec(3) + 2*ti(5)*vec(2)*vec(3))
   981	      tiv = [ti(1)*vec(1) + ti(2)*vec(2) + ti(4)*vec(3), &
   982	         & ti(2)*vec(1) + ti(3)*vec(2) + ti(5)*vec(3), &
   983	         & ti(4)*vec(1) + ti(5)*vec(2) + ti(6)*vec(3)]
   984	      tjv = [tj(1)*vec(1) + tj(2)*vec(2) + tj(4)*vec(3), &
   985	         & tj(2)*vec(1) + tj(3)*vec(2) + tj(5)*vec(3), &
   986	         & tj(4)*vec(1) + tj(5)*vec(2) + tj(6)*vec(3)]
   987	
   988	      dg(:) = dg + vec * sink * (qiqpj + qpiqj)
   989	      do b = 1, 3
   990	         do a = 1, 3
   991	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
   992	               & + cosk * (qiqpj + qpiqj) * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
   993	               & - cosk*(vec(a)*(qi*tjv(b) + qj*tiv(b)) + vec(b)*(qi*tjv(a) + qj*tiv(a)))
   994	         end do
   995	      end do
   996	   end do
   997	
   998	end subroutine get_damat_sdq_rec_3d
   999	
  1000	pure subroutine get_damat_sdq_dir_3d(rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, &
  1001	      & alp, trans, de, dg, ds)
  1002	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
  1003	   real(wp), intent(in) :: qi, qj, mi(3), mj(3), ti(6), tj(6)
  1004	   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
  1005	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
  1006	   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
  1007	   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
  1008	   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
  1009	   real(wp), intent(out) :: de
  1010	   real(wp), intent(out) :: dg(3)
  1011	   real(wp), intent(out) :: ds(3, 3)
  1012	
  1013	   integer :: itr, k, a, b, c
  1014	   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, r2, g1, g3, g5, g7, fdmp3, fdmp5, ddmp3, ddmp5, dpiqj, qidpj
  1015	   real(wp) :: alp2, arg, arg2, erft, expt, e1, e2, e3, tabc(3, 3, 3), tab(3, 3)
  1016	   real(wp) :: dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, edd, eq, g_sd(3), g_dd(3), g_sq(3)
  1017	
  1018	   de = 0.0_wp
  1019	   dg(:) = 0.0_wp
  1020	   ds(:, :) = 0.0_wp
  1021	
  1022	   alp2 = alp*alp
  1023	
  1024	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
  1025	      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
  1026	      r1 = norm2(vec)
  1027	      if (r1 < eps) cycle
  1028	      r2 = r1 * r1
  1029	      g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
  1030	      g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
  1031	      g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
  1032	      g7 = g5 * g1 * g1
  1033	
  1034	      arg = r1*alp
  1035	      arg2 = arg*arg
  1036	      erft = -erf(arg)*g1
  1037	      expt = exp(-arg2)/sqrtpi
  1038	      e1 = g1*g1 * (erft + expt*(2*alp2)/alp)
  1039	      e2 = g1*g1 * (e1 + expt*(2*alp2)**2/(3*alp))
  1040	      e3 = g1*g1 * (e2 + expt*(2*alp2)**3/(15*alp))
  1041	
  1042	      fdmp3 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
  1043	      ddmp3 = -3*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3-1.0_wp)
  1044	      fdmp5 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
  1045	      ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5-fdmp5)
  1046	
  1047	      dpiqj = dot_product(vec, mi)*qj
  1048	      qidpj = dot_product(vec, mj)*qi
  1049	      dpidpj = dot_product(mj, mi)
  1050	      dpiv = dot_product(mi, vec)
  1051	      dpjv = dot_product(mj, vec)
  1052	      edd = dpidpj*r2 - 3*dpjv*dpiv
  1053	
  1054	      ! Charge - dipole
  1055	      g_sd(:) = - (ddmp3*g5)*vec * (dpiqj - qidpj) + fdmp3*g3*(qi*mj - qj*mi)
  1056	
  1057	      do b = 1, 3
  1058	         do a = 1, 3
  1059	            tab(a, b) = 3*vec(a)*vec(b)*e2
  1060	         end do
  1061	         tab(b, b) = tab(b, b) - e1
  1062	      end do
  1063	
  1064	      do k = 1, 3
  1065	         g_sd(k) = g_sd(k) &
  1066	            & + qj * (tab(1, k) * mi(1) &
  1067	            &       + tab(2, k) * mi(2) &
  1068	            &       + tab(3, k) * mi(3))&
  1069	            & - qi * (tab(1, k) * mj(1) &
  1070	            &       + tab(2, k) * mj(2) &
  1071	            &       + tab(3, k) * mj(3))
  1072	      end do
  1073	
  1074	      de = de + 3.0_wp*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
  1075	      dg(:) = dg + g_sd
  1076	      ds(:, :) = ds - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(g_sd, 2, 3) &
  1077	         & + spread(g_sd, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
  1078	
  1079	      ! Dipole - dipole
  1080	      g_dd(:) = - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*dpidpj*vec &
  1081	         & + 3.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*mj + dpjv*mi) &
  1082	         & - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec
  1083	
  1084	      do c = 1, 3
  1085	         do b = 1, 3
  1086	            do a = 1, 3
  1087	               tabc(a, b, c) = - 15*vec(a)*vec(b)*vec(c)*e3
  1088	            end do
  1089	         end do
  1090	         do a = 1, 3
  1091	            tabc(a, a, c) = tabc(a, a, c) + 3*e2*vec(c)
  1092	            tabc(c, a, c) = tabc(c, a, c) + 3*e2*vec(a)
  1093	            tabc(a, c, c) = tabc(a, c, c) + 3*e2*vec(a)
  1094	         end do
  1095	      end do
  1096	
  1097	      do k = 1, 3
  1098	         g_dd(k) = g_dd(k) &
  1099	            & + mi(1)*(tabc(1, 1, k) * mj(1) &
  1100	            &        + tabc(2, 1, k) * mj(2) &
  1101	            &        + tabc(3, 1, k) * mj(3))&
  1102	            & + mi(2)*(tabc(1, 2, k) * mj(1) &
  1103	            &        + tabc(2, 2, k) * mj(2) &
  1104	            &        + tabc(3, 2, k) * mj(3))&
  1105	            & + mi(3)*(tabc(1, 3, k) * mj(1) &
  1106	            &        + tabc(2, 3, k) * mj(2) &
  1107	            &        + tabc(3, 3, k) * mj(3))
  1108	      end do
  1109	
  1110	      de = de + 3.0_wp*edd*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*(fdmp5/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
  1111	      dg(:) = dg + g_dd
  1112	      ds(:, :) = ds - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(g_dd, 2, 3) &
  1113	         & + spread(g_dd, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
  1114	
  1115	      ! Charge - quadrupole
  1116	      eq = &
  1117	         & + 2*(qj*ti(2) + tj(2)*qi)*vec(1)*vec(2) &
  1118	         & + 2*(qj*ti(4) + tj(4)*qi)*vec(1)*vec(3) &
  1119	         & + 2*(qj*ti(5) + tj(5)*qi)*vec(2)*vec(3) &
  1120	         & + (qj*ti(1) + tj(1)*qi)*vec(1)*vec(1) &
  1121	         & + (qj*ti(3) + tj(3)*qi)*vec(2)*vec(2) &
  1122	         & + (qj*ti(6) + tj(6)*qi)*vec(3)*vec(3)
  1123	
  1124	      g_sq(:) = - eq*ddmp5*g7*vec &
  1125	         & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qi * &
  1126	         &[vec(1)*tj(1) + vec(2)*tj(2) + vec(3)*tj(4), &
  1127	         & vec(1)*tj(2) + vec(2)*tj(3) + vec(3)*tj(5), &
  1128	         & vec(1)*tj(4) + vec(2)*tj(5) + vec(3)*tj(6)] &
  1129	         & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qj * &
  1130	         &[vec(1)*ti(1) + vec(2)*ti(2) + vec(3)*ti(4), &
  1131	         & vec(1)*ti(2) + vec(2)*ti(3) + vec(3)*ti(5), &
  1132	         & vec(1)*ti(4) + vec(2)*ti(5) + vec(3)*ti(6)]
  1133	
  1134	      do k = 1, 3
  1135	         g_sq(k) = g_sq(k) + (&
  1136	            & - qi * (tabc(1, 1, k) * tj(1) &
  1137	            &     + 2*tabc(2, 1, k) * tj(2) &
  1138	            &     + 2*tabc(3, 1, k) * tj(4) &
  1139	            &     +   tabc(2, 2, k) * tj(3) &
  1140	            &     + 2*tabc(3, 2, k) * tj(5) &
  1141	            &     +   tabc(3, 3, k) * tj(6))&
  1142	            & - qj * (tabc(1, 1, k) * ti(1) &
  1143	            &     + 2*tabc(2, 1, k) * ti(2) &
  1144	            &     + 2*tabc(3, 1, k) * ti(4) &
  1145	            &     +   tabc(2, 2, k) * ti(3) &
  1146	            &     + 2*tabc(3, 2, k) * ti(5) &
  1147	            &     +   tabc(3, 3, k) * ti(6)))/3.0_wp
  1148	      end do
  1149	
  1150	      de = de + eq * 3.0_wp*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*fdmp5/rr*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
  1151	      dg(:) = dg + g_sq
  1152	      ds(:, :) = ds - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(g_sq, 2, 3) &
  1153	         & + spread(g_sq, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))
  1154	   end do
  1155	
  1156	end subroutine get_damat_sdq_dir_3d

  1161	   use tblite_scf_info, only : scf_info, atom_resolved
  1162	   !> Instance of the electrostatic container

  1171	!> Inspect container cache and reallocate it in case of type mismatch
  1172	subroutine taint(cache, ptr)
  1173	   !> Instance of the container cache
  1174	   type(container_cache), target, intent(inout) :: cache
  1175	   !> Reference to the container cache
  1176	   type(coulomb_cache), pointer, intent(out) :: ptr
  1177	
  1178	   if (allocated(cache%raw)) then
  1179	      call view(cache, ptr)
  1180	      if (associated(ptr)) return
  1181	      deallocate(cache%raw)
  1182	   end if
  1183

!> Return cutoff for reciprocal contributions
function get_rec_cutoff(alpha, volume, conv, multipole) result(x)
   !> Parameter of Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Volume of the unit cell
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance value
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Use multipole (1/R^3) decay to determine the cutoff
   logical, intent(in), optional :: multipole
   !> Magnitude of reciprocal vector
   real(wp) :: x

   class(term_type), allocatable :: term

   if (present(multipole)) then
      if (multipole) then
         term = rec_3d_mp_term()
      else
         term = rec_3d_term()
      end if
   else
      term = rec_3d_term()
   end if
   x = search_cutoff(term, alpha, volume, conv)

end function get_rec_cutoff


!> Return cutoff for real-space contributions
function get_dir_cutoff(alpha, conv, multipole) result(x)
   !> Parameter of Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Use multipole (1/R^3) decay to determine the cutoff
   logical, intent(in), optional :: multipole
   !> Magnitude of real-space vector

subroutine get_dir_trans(lattice, alpha, conv, trans)
   !> Lattice parameters
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:, :)
   !> Parameter for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Translation vectors
   real(wp), allocatable, intent(out) :: trans(:, :)

   call get_lattice_points([.true.], lattice, get_dir_cutoff(alpha, conv, multipole=.true.), trans)

end subroutine get_dir_trans

!> Get reciprocal lattice translations
subroutine get_rec_trans(lattice, alpha, volume, conv, trans)
   !> Lattice parameters
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:, :)
   !> Parameter for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Cell volume
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Translation vectors
   real(wp), allocatable, intent(out) :: trans(:, :)

   real(wp) :: rec_lat(3, 3)

   rec_lat = twopi*transpose(matinv_3x3(lattice))
   call get_lattice_points([.true.], rec_lat, get_rec_cutoff(alpha, volume, conv, multipole=.true.), trans)
   trans = trans(:, 2:)

end subroutine get_rec_trans
